# T-3: Derive FAIL reason summary in the article parser

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Inside parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation, write a derived `reason` field on each FAIL entry by joining '<target> — <why_violates> (at <where>)' across all violations with '; ' separator. The derived value replaces any model-supplied reason on FAIL.

## Acceptance Criteria
- After parsing, every FAIL article entry carries a non-empty reason string equal to violations.map(v => `${v.target} — ${v.why_violates} (at ${v.where})`).join('; ').
- PASS / SKIP entries carry the reason supplied by the model unchanged.
- Unit test asserts the exact derived string for a fixture with 2 violations and a fixture with 1 violation, including the `(at <where>)` suffix.

## Implementation Notes
Logically T-3 is a sub-concern of T-2 but kept separate so the test surface for the derived-reason contract is explicit. If T-2 implements the derivation inline, T-3 collapses into T-2's tests.

## Test Strategy
Pure-function unit test on parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation with fixed JSON inputs; assert exact derived `reason` string.
